prompt: /hamburger-method We need to notify users when a product they're watching drops in price

assertions.text: Identifies functional layers (detect event, identify recipients, format message, deliver, track) NOT horizontal technical layers (frontend, backend, database)
Generates at least 4 distinct options for EACH layer — not just 'simple vs complex'
Options within each layer follow a quality gradient from manual/hardcoded to automated/scalable
The proposed smallest vertical slice uses level-1 or level-2 options (manual/scripted) — NOT level-4 or level-5 options
The smallest slice is end-to-end: covers all layers, even if at the lowest quality level
Proposes at least 2 follow-up slices that improve one or two layers incrementally
